subject: test(ssh_dotnet): consolidate duplicate test files; add [Category] taxonomy
body:
test(ssh_dotnet): consolidate duplicate test files; add [Category] taxonomy

Remove the older, diverged duplicate SSH_DotNet test files under
Connection/Protocol/ (kept the more comprehensive Connection/Protocol/SSH_DotNet/
copies). The deleted copies' unique success-path key-load tests used a hardcoded
key string and are superseded by the runtime BouncyCastle TestKeyFactory planned
for the cert-feature phase.

Add [Category("Unit")] to the pure-logic SSH_DotNet test fixtures and
[Category("RequiresUI")] to SshTerminalControlTests, so the local Win10 run can
filter to fast unit tests.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: Test consolidation for SSH_DotNet suite that only exists in that fork; no corresponding code or tests in ours.
